evidence.curator_note: GENERIC SCHEME, lower (doubly-bonded) form of eq 8.44. The book braces the two forms together as resonance depictions of ONE even-electron ion (EE+); this record encodes the lower form AB-C=D with the charge (+) on the doubly-bonded atom C and a full arrow labelled 'i' to AB+ + C=D. No atoms, m/z or intensities are printed. Instantiation chosen by the curator: the ethyl oxocarbenium ion in its oxonium resonance form CH3CH2-O(+)=CH2 (map 3 = C-of-scheme = O+ double-bonded, carrying the +; map 4 = D = terminal CH2; AB = ethyl, maps 1-2). Inductive cleavage: the CH2-O sigma bond (bond 2-3) breaks heterolytically, both electrons collapsing onto O as a new lone pair (charge migrates from O to the ethyl fragment), giving the ethyl cation CH3CH2+ (AB+) and neutral formaldehyde O=CH2 (C=D, the O=CH2 double bond order is unchanged). ARC COUNT: the book draws 1 arc (a single full/double-barbed arrow from the AB-C sigma bond to the + charge site on C); move <1> IS that drawn arc, one 2-electron move to the heteroatom lone pair. The arrow-checker flags atom 3 as a soft 'lone pair rather than radicals' note (the +2 non-bonding population is a lone pair, no radical). Same net reaction as the braced partner IMS8-EQ8.44a and identical to the concrete eq-8.10 record.

No MØD rule is indexed for eq 8.44 (rule_index.json by_equation has no '8.44' entry); no cross-link to verify, no rule_mismatch to report. VERIFIED RELATED RULE: IMS_8_10 (eq 8.10) encodes exactly this bond change. Its DFS [C]1(H3)[C]5(H2)[O+]8{=}[C]9(H2) >> [C]1(H3)[C+]5(H2).[O]8{=}[C]9(H2) is this substrate CH3CH2-O(+)=CH2: it cleaves the C5-O8 sigma bond, migrates +1 to the ethyl carbon C5 and leaves neutral O8=C9 formaldehyde -> ethyl+ + O=CH2, the identical transformation. IMS_8_10 is indexed under eq 8.10, not eq 8.44, so it is a related realization rather than an 8.44 cross-link.

m/z 29.0386 is the monoisotopic mass of the ethyl cation C2H5+ from the curator's chosen instantiation of the generic AB+ fragment; it is NOT printed on the page. Generic scheme with no printed m/z or intensity, hence status 'inferred', detected=false, no relative_intensity.
